538:     ) -> Result<PipelineData, ShellError> {
539:         let span = call.head;
540:         let ctrlc = engine_state.ctrlc.clone();
541:         let engine_state = engine_state.clone();
542:         let config = engine_state.get_config().clone();
543:         let filter_config = engine_state.get_config().clone();
544:         let invert = call.has_flag(&engine_state, stack, "invert")?;
545:         let terms = call.rest::<Value>(&engine_state, stack, 0)?;
546:         let lower_terms = self.folded_term_values(&terms, &config, span);
547: 
548:         let (string_style, highlight_style) =
549:             self.compute_search_styles(&engine_state, stack, span);
550: 
551:         let cols_to_search_in_map: Vec<_> = call
552:             .get_flag(&engine_state, stack, "columns")?
553:             .unwrap_or_default();
554: 
555:         let cols_to_search_in_filter = cols_to_search_in_map.clone();
556:         let finder = self.clone();
557:         let finder_filter = self.clone();
558: 
559:         match input {
560:             PipelineData::Empty => Ok(PipelineData::Empty),
561:             PipelineData::Value(_, _) => {
562:                 let highlight_finder = finder.clone();
563:                 input
564:                     .map(
565:                         move |mut x| {
566:                             let span = x.span();
567:                             match &mut x {
568:                                 Value::Record { val, .. } => highlight_finder
569:                                     .highlight_terms_in_record_with_search_columns(
570:                                         &cols_to_search_in_map,
571:                                         val,
572:                                         span,
573:                                         &config,
574:                                         &terms,
575:                                         string_style,
576:                                         highlight_style,
577:                                     ),
578:                                 Value::String { .. } => highlight_finder.highlight_terms_in_string(
579:                                     &x,
580:                                     span,
581:                                     &config,
582:                                     &terms,
583:                                     string_style,
584:                                     highlight_style,
585:                                 ),
586:                                 _ => x,
587:                             }
588:                         },
589:                         ctrlc.clone(),
590:                     )?
591:                     .filter(
592:                         move |value| {
593:                             finder_filter.value_should_be_printed(
594:                                 value,
595:                                 &filter_config,
596:                                 &lower_terms,
597:                                 span,
598:                                 &cols_to_search_in_filter,
599:                                 invert,
600:                             )
601:                         },
602:                         ctrlc,
603:                     )
604:             }
605:             PipelineData::ListStream(stream, metadata) => {
606:                 let stream = stream.modify(|iter| {
607:                     let map_finder = finder.clone();
608:                     let filter_finder = finder.clone();
609:                     let cols_to_search_in_map = cols_to_search_in_map.clone();
610:                     let cols_to_search_in_filter = cols_to_search_in_filter.clone();
611:                     let terms = terms.clone();
612:                     let config = config.clone();
613:                     let filter_config = filter_config.clone();
614:                     let lower_terms = lower_terms.clone();
615:                     iter.map(move |mut x| {
616:                         let span = x.span();
617:                         match &mut x {
618:                             Value::Record { val, .. } => map_finder
619:                                 .highlight_terms_in_record_with_search_columns(
620:                                     &cols_to_search_in_map,
621:                                     val,
622:                                     span,
623:                                     &config,
624:                                     &terms,
625:                                     string_style,
626:                                     highlight_style,
627:                                 ),
628:                             _ => x,
629:                         }
630:                     })
631:                     .filter(move |value| {
632:                         filter_finder.value_should_be_printed(
633:                             value,
634:                             &filter_config,
635:                             &lower_terms,
636:                             span,
637:                             &cols_to_search_in_filter,
638:                             invert,
639:                         )
640:                     })
641:                 });
642: 
643:                 Ok(PipelineData::ListStream(stream, metadata))
644:             }
645:             PipelineData::ByteStream(stream, ..) => {
646:                 let span = stream.span();
647:                 if let Some(lines) = stream.lines() {
648:                     let terms = lower_terms
649:                         .into_iter()
650:                         .map(|term| finder.fold_text(&term.to_expanded_string("", &filter_config)))
651:                         .collect::<Vec<_>>();
652: 
653:                     let mut output: Vec<Value> = vec![];
654:                     for line in lines {
655:                         let line = line?.to_lowercase();
656:                         for term in &terms {
657:                             if line.contains(term) {
658:                                 output.push(Value::string(
659:                                     finder.highlight_search_string(
660:                                         &line,
661:                                         term,
662:                                         &string_style,
663:                                         &highlight_style,
664:                                     )?,
665:                                     span,
666:                                 ))
667:                             }
668:                         }
669:                     }
670:                     Ok(Value::list(output, span).into_pipeline_data())
671:                 } else {
672:                     Ok(PipelineData::Empty)
673:                 }
674:             }
675:         }
676:     }

712:     fn highlight_regex_for_term(&self, needle: &str) -> Result<Regex, ShellError> {
713:         let regex_string = if !self.paint_unmatched_prefix && needle.is_empty() {
714:             "(?i)".to_string()
715:         } else {
716:             format!("(?i){needle}")
717:         };
718:         match Regex::new(&regex_string) {
719:             Ok(regex) => Ok(regex),
720:             Err(err) => Err(ShellError::GenericError {
721:                 error: "Could not compile regex".into(),
722:                 msg: err.to_string(),
723:                 span: Some(Span::test_data()),
724:                 help: None,
725:                 inner: vec![],
726:             }),
727:         }
728:     }

733:         } else {
734:             searched_cols.iter().any(|col| *col == column)
735:         }

746:     pub(crate) fn highlight_search_string(
747:         &self,
748:         haystack: &str,
749:         needle: &str,
750:         string_style: &Style,
751:         highlight_style: &Style,
752:     ) -> Result<String, ShellError> {
753:         let regex = self.highlight_regex_for_term(needle)?;
754:         if haystack.is_empty() && !self.paint_unmatched_prefix {
755:             return Ok(String::new());
756:         }
757:         let stripped_haystack = nu_utils::strip_ansi_likely(haystack);
758:         let mut last_match_end = 0;
759:         let mut highlighted = String::new();
760: 
761:         for cap in regex.captures_iter(stripped_haystack.as_ref()) {
762:             match cap {
763:                 Ok(capture) => {
764:                     let start = match capture.get(0) {
765:                         Some(acap) => acap.start(),
766:                         None => 0,
767:                     };
768:                     let end = match capture.get(0) {
769:                         Some(acap) => acap.end(),
770:                         None => 0,
771:                     };
772:                     highlighted.push_str(&self.paint_plain_segment(
773:                         string_style,
774:                         &stripped_haystack[last_match_end..start],
775:                     ));
776:                     highlighted.push_str(
777:                         &self.paint_match_segment(highlight_style, &stripped_haystack[start..end]),
778:                     );
779:                     last_match_end = end;
780:                 }
781:                 Err(e) => {
782:                     return Err(ShellError::GenericError {
783:                         error: "Error with regular expression capture".into(),
784:                         msg: e.to_string(),
785:                         span: None,
786:                         help: None,
787:                         inner: vec![],
788:                     });
789:                 }
790:             }
791:         }
792: 
793:         highlighted.push_str(
794:             &self.paint_plain_segment(string_style, &stripped_haystack[last_match_end..]),
795:         );
796:         Ok(highlighted)
797:     }

799:     pub(crate) fn highlight_search_in_table(
800:         &self,
801:         table: Vec<Value>,
802:         search_string: &str,
803:         searched_cols: &[&str],
804:         string_style: &Style,
805:         highlight_style: &Style,
806:     ) -> Result<Vec<Value>, ShellError> {
807:         let orig_search_string = search_string;
808:         if search_string.is_empty() && !self.paint_unmatched_prefix {
809:             return Ok(Vec::new());
810:         }
811:         let search_string = search_string.to_folded_case();
812:         let mut matches = vec![];
813: 
814:         for mut value in table {
815:             let Value::Record {
816:                 val: ref mut record,
817:                 ..
818:             } = value
819:             else {
820:                 return Err(ShellError::NushellFailedSpanned {
821:                     msg: "Expected record".to_string(),
822:                     label: format!("got {}", value.get_type()),
823:                     span: value.span(),
824:                 });
825:             };
826: 
827:             let has_match = record.to_mut().iter_mut().try_fold(
828:                 false,
829:                 |acc: bool, (col, val)| -> Result<bool, ShellError> {
830:                     if !self.record_has_searchable_column(col, searched_cols) {
831:                         return Ok(acc);
832:                     }
833:                     let span = val.span();
834:                     if let Value::String { val: s, .. } = val {
835:                         if s.to_folded_case().contains(&search_string) {
836:                             *val = self.apply_string_highlight(
837:                                 s,
838:                                 self.highlight_search_string(
839:                                     s,
840:                                     orig_search_string,
841:                                     string_style,
842:                                     highlight_style,
843:                                 )?,
844:                                 span,
845:                             );
846:                             return Ok(true);
847:                         }
848:                     }
849:                     Ok(acc)
850:                 },
851:             )?;
852: 
853:             if has_match {
854:                 matches.push(value);
855:             }
856:         }
857: 
858:         Ok(matches)
859:     }

861:     fn highlight_terms_in_string(
862:         &self,
863:         val: &Value,
864:         span: Span,
865:         config: &Config,
866:         terms: &[Value],
867:         string_style: Style,
868:         highlight_style: Style,

872:             return val.clone();

875:         if let Some(term) = terms
876:             .iter()
877:             .find(|term| self.contains_ignore_case(&val_str, &term.to_expanded_string("", config)))

881:                 .highlight_search_string(&val_str, &term_str, &string_style, &highlight_style)
882:                 .unwrap_or_else(|_| self.paint_match_segment(&string_style, &term_str));

890:     #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
891:     fn highlight_terms_in_record_with_search_columns(
892:         &self,
893:         search_cols: &[String],
894:         record: &Record,
895:         span: Span,
896:         config: &Config,
897:         terms: &[Value],
898:         string_style: Style,
899:         highlight_style: Style,
900:     ) -> Value {
901:         let col_select = !search_cols.is_empty();
902:         if record.is_empty() && !self.paint_unmatched_prefix {
903:             return Value::record(record.clone(), span);
904:         }
905:         let term_strs: Vec<_> = terms
906:             .iter()
907:             .map(|v| v.to_expanded_string("", config))
908:             .collect();
909: 
910:         let mut record = record.clone();
911:         for (col, val) in record.iter_mut() {
912:             if col_select && !search_cols.contains(col) {
913:                 continue;
914:             }
915:             if !col_select && self.highlight_string_key.is_empty() {
916:                 continue;
917:             }
918:             let val_str = val.to_expanded_string("", config);
919:             let Some(term_str) = term_strs
920:                 .iter()
921:                 .find(|term_str| self.contains_ignore_case(&val_str, term_str))
922:             else {
923:                 continue;
924:             };
925: 
926:             let highlighted_str = self
927:                 .highlight_search_string(&val_str, term_str, &string_style, &highlight_style)
928:                 .unwrap_or_else(|_| string_style.paint(term_str).to_string());
929: 
930:             *val = Value::string(highlighted_str, span);
931:         }
932: 
933:         Value::record(record, span)
934:     }

952:     pub(crate) fn boolean_fold(
953:         &self,
954:         engine_state: &EngineState,
955:         stack: &mut Stack,
956:         call: &Call,
957:         input: PipelineData,
958:         accumulator: bool,
959:     ) -> Result<PipelineData, ShellError> {
960:         let head = call.head;
961:         let closure: Closure = call.req(engine_state, stack, 0)?;
962:         let mut closure = ClosureEval::new(engine_state, stack, closure);
963: 
964:         for value in input {
965:             if nu_utils::ctrl_c::was_pressed(&engine_state.ctrlc) {
966:                 break;
967:             }
968: 
969:             let pred = closure.run_with_value(value)?.into_value(head)?.is_true();
970: 
971:             if self.fold_short_circuit && pred == accumulator {
972:                 if self.wrap_eval_errors || pred == accumulator {
973:                     return Ok(Value::bool(accumulator, head).into_pipeline_data());
974:                 }
975:             }
976:         }
977: 
978:         Ok(Value::bool(!accumulator, head).into_pipeline_data())
979:     }

999:     fn filter_iterable_values(
1000:         &self,
1001:         engine_state: &EngineState,
1002:         stack: &mut Stack,
1003:         head: Span,
1004:         input: PipelineData,
1005:         closure: Closure,
1006:     ) -> PipelineData {
1007:         let finder = self.clone();
1008:         let wrap_eval_errors = self.wrap_eval_errors;
1009:         let mut closure = ClosureEval::new(engine_state, stack, closure);
1010:         input
1011:             .into_iter()
1012:             .filter_map(move |value| {
1013:                 match closure
1014:                     .run_with_value(value.clone())
1015:                     .and_then(|data| data.into_value(head))
1016:                 {
1017:                     Ok(cond) => cond.is_true().then_some(value),
1018:                     Err(err) => {
1019:                         if wrap_eval_errors {
1020:                             Some(finder.wrap_predicate_error(err, &value, head))
1021:                         } else {
1022:                             Some(Value::error(err, value.span()))
1023:                         }
1024:                     }
1025:                 }
1026:             })
1027:             .into_pipeline_data(head, engine_state.ctrlc.clone())
1028:     }
